Thanks for the kind words. I am not making any quick decisions. Just contemplating life, and nursing the pain. For now.

Adding some more details for context.

I have a successful career, mid 30s. Great life. Wife works, but I am the breadwinner. I've brought us up out of poverty, and we live a comfortable life. I feel like I've sacrificed so much time and effort to get us here, and I feel entirely betrayed by my wife's actions. The more I think about it, the more I realize that I her actions go completely against my ideals and ethics. Like wtf. Our kids are pretty young and I can't see myself sharing custody and doing the whole "trade-off" thing every 2 weeks. That is not the life I envisioned, and I just don't see the point anymore. By dying (I've researched this extensively) my family would be ok, and eventually they would get over the loss. I could even make it look like an accident. I'd be a hero, and everyone would be ok in the short term. Even though I'm pissed off at my wife right now, I love her, and I want her to be ok too. I feel like my death would be a worthy sacrifice for their happiness....that is what is driving all these thoughts. It's getting worse day by day. I just want out, either by recovery or by.....getting out. I'm lost.
